AE notes: strong initial interest, technical fit good; Redwood POC showed competitive latency/cost estimates but procurement prioritized simplicity.
From the CIO (paraphrase): 'We need the fastest path to production — minimal integration overhead. OpenAI checks the box.'

Procurement rationale: existing relationship with cloud vendor, consolidated billing, and perceived lower time-to-launch with OpenAI.
